services.description:
Enjoy a good workout session in our spacious gymnasium equipped with state-of-the-art equipment.

In view of updates to Safe Management Measures from 10 August 2021, residents will be allowed to use the gym (with capped capacity) if residents are fully vaccinated.
Take a dip in the cool waters of our infinity pool - the perfect way to refresh and unwind after a day in the office or after hours of exploration.

services.description: Enjoy modern Asian fusion cuisine at our bistro. Open for breakfast, lunch and dinner. In-room dining services are also available.
Decorated to make you feel at home, our Residents’ Lounge is made for relaxation. Grab a book off the shelves or simply enjoy an aromatic coffee with our compliments.

For greater comfort and reassurance during your stay, round-the-clock health, wellness and security support including telehealth or non-emergency medical consultation, updates on health and security situations within the property vicinity or the destination you are travelling to is available a call away. More info here.

The property is thoughtfully equipped to cater to guests with physical impairments. Accessible rooms are designed for comfort, and safety is prioritized with conveniently located accessible toilets featuring clear emergency instructions. Wheelchair ramps, a dedicated service lift from the ground floor to the main lobby, and standard lifts ensure smooth navigation throughout the property. Our staff are also trained to assist guests with disabilities, ensuring a comfortable and inclusive experience.

The property is thoughtfully equipped to cater to guests with visual impairments, featuring braille signage in lifts to aid navigation.

Do contact our property if you would like to find out more.

Our space is impeccably appointed with carefully curated essentials and thoughtful details, creating a seamless and comfortable experience from the moment you arrive.
